subfiles.title: Japanese financial and economic statistics, concluding tables and colophon
subfiles.about: Monthly tables record the condition of Japanese financial institutions, markets, prices, public debt, and corporate capital.
subfiles.summary: The concluding pages tabulate assets and liabilities of banks, trust companies, insurers, credit cooperatives, and other financial institutions, along with postal and government savings. They also cover securities trading, Tokyo price indexes, government bond and short-term security issues, and corporate capital. Figures generally extend through November 1946. The colophon states that the publication was printed on January 20 and issued on January 25, 1947.
